environment.note: Phase 5 wave 2a: the three engine gaps (pre_output aux placement, data outputs, arity-0) were closed first, then these six entries curated against them. To be re-verified on macOS r8 by the CDP-gated suite (new gated tests in tests/test_pre_output_aux.py / test_data_outputs.py / test_arity0.py). .for and .evl outputs are RIFF containers with the same per-run LIST date chunk as .ana - determinism judged on the data chunk.

notes: UNBLOCKED by the position:'pre_output' ParameterSpec field this entry motivated (tranche-5 dropped[0]): argv renders 'submix mix <mixfile> <outfile>' with the mixfile before the output. input_arity 0 - the sources live inside the mixfile; lineage records an empty inputs list. Engine argv lineage-verified: 'submix mix data/ev.mix graphs/<gid>/n1_submix-mix.wav'.

Tranche-5 empirics treated as spec and spot-re-verified: outdur = max(start+dur) - min(start) sample-exact (n1@0+n2@0.5 -> 2.5000; lone event@1.0 -> 1.0000, leading silence stripped); summation exactly linear (2 x 0.5-level copies bit-identical to source); OVERLOAD WRAPS (3 full-level copies == wrap_int16(3x) to 1 LSB, 22287 overs). known_issues carry the mandated pair: overload-WRAPS warning + 'submix getlevel 1 <mixfile>' pre-flight guidance (mode digit required; prints MAX SAMPLE + NORMALISATION REQUIRED).

NEW FINDING: -g (exposed as atten, 0.000001-1.0) is applied to the float sum BEFORE 16-bit quantisation - getlevel's NORMALISATION REQUIRED factor (0.336683 on the wrap case) renders CLEAN (correlation 1.0 with the ideal scaled sum, peak ~1.0). Contrast tranche 5's -a flag (byte-identical no-op on the same case; not exposed). -g0 accepted by CDP but renders silence - curated min keeps it nonzero. -s/-e crop flags banner-marked test-only, not exposed.

duration_model is expression 'mixfile' - deliberately references the non-scalar aux param so the existing pre-flight guard skips (the real rule cannot be computed engine-side; durations live inside the mixfile). duration_row indur is null (arity-0) and the row does NOT fit the shared formula fixture (no input to write; aux mixfile needed) - pinned instead by the gated test_submix_mix_real_cdp_duration_rule.

Mixfile rules in the entry (from tranche 5, unchanged): line syntax 'sndname start chans level [pan...]'; chans must match the file; plain negative levels refused ('-6dB' form works); pan 'C' does NOT mean centre; relative paths resolve against the process cwd = session root ('inputs/x.wav', 'graphs/<gid>/x.wav'), never the mixfile's directory; no spaces in paths; all sources one sample rate; all-mono no-pan -> mono out, any pan/stereo -> stereo. Deterministic.

UNBLOCKED by pre_output (tranche-5 dropped[3]): 'formants put 1 infile fmntfile outfile [-i][-l][-h][-g]' - the .for slot sits between input and output, expressed as an aux_file with position 'pre_output' (binary aux data, not text - the aux_file docstring was widened accordingly). It is NOT input 2 (.for stays unknown_input_domain to the PVOC gate, by design).

duration_model expression 'indur' - output duration = the input .ana's duration regardless of the .for's length (2 s -> 2.029070; 1 s .ana + 2 s .for -> 1.026163; the usual ~+1.5% pvoc grid overhead, inside the 5% tolerance). duration_row does NOT fit the shared formula fixture (needs a .for aux the fixture cannot supply - grain rerhythm precedent); the get->put chain is pinned by the gated test_formants_get_put_chain_real_cdp.
Mode 1 (formants REPLACE the sound's own) pinned; mode 2 (impose on top) is data-chunk-distinct (verified) and reachable via execute(). -i quicksearch (mode 1 only per banner) changes the render.

Ranges (verbatim): -l 'Parameter[1] ... (5.000000 to 22050.000000)'; -h 'Parameter[2]' same range; -g 'Parameter[3] ... (0.000002 to 40.000000)' - NOTE gain max 40 here vs formants vocode's 10 (-g20 accepted). Breakpoints all refused ('brkpnt_files not permitted', parameters 1/2/3).
A non-formant aux file refuses cleanly: 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: cannot open input file <name> to read data.' Deterministic in the data chunk; -i/-l/-h/-g change the render.

UNBLOCKED by the data-output kind (tranche-5 dropped[2]): output_format '.for' - the engine names the output .for, verifies exists + non-empty (never RMS), skips the duration pre-flight, and the PVOC gate keeps it out of audio inputs. duration_row tolerance null: a data file has no audio duration to measure (duration_model 'static' is a schema placeholder; documented in the entry).

POISON RE-VERIFIED (the reason for the output kind): a get output named .ana reports sfprops -d = 107.848839 s from a 2 s source; named .wav, soundfile 'reads' it as sr-344 audio. Both recorded in the entry's known_issues.
Exactly one of -f/-p required (neither: 'Insufficient parameters on command line'; both: 'Unknown flag -f on command line.'). Entry pins -p (fbands default 8, same as vocode); -f via execute().

Ranges match the vocode findings: -p13 'Too many formant_bands requested: max for this file is 12' (input-dependent); -p0 accepted (curated out, min 1); -p2.5 accepted; -f0 crashes 'INTERNAL ERROR ... set_specenv_frqs()'; -f max 256. -p brk refused ('Cannot read count of formant_bands.').

Deterministic in the RIFF data chunk (148400 bytes at -p8 on the 2 s tone analysis). Consumer surface: formants put's fmntfile aux param (session-relative 'graphs/<gid>/<node>_formants-get.for') - the get-once/put-many split of the already-shipped formants vocode.

UNBLOCKED by the data-output kind (tranche-5 dropped[1]): output_format '.evl'. The binary writes a RIFF/WAVE-dressed envelope (FLOAT subtype, sample rate 57, 115 frames for 2 s at wsize 20, ~2530 bytes; wsize 2000 -> 1 float, 2074 bytes) under ANY name - naming it .evl and verifying as data (exists + non-empty, no RMS decode) removes the pseudo-wav poison. Duration pre-flight skips (duration_row tolerance null - no audio duration; duration_model 'static' is a placeholder).

Envelope fidelity: the stored floats correlate at r = 0.99 with the source's per-window PEAK trajectory. Window count runs above dur/wsize (115 windows for 2 s at wsize 20 = effective ~17.4 ms) - CDP's rounding, noted in the entry.

wsize: CDP-enforced 5 to the INPUT's length in ms ('(5.000000 to 2000.000000)' on 2 s; 4 and 2001 refused); fractional accepted (12.5); brk refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 ... brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Entry default 20 (always emitted). Stereo input accepted -> 'any'.

Round-trip verified for the consumer path: 'envel impose 2 tone2.wav e1.evl rt.wav' (mode 2 takes NO wsize) -> exit 0, 2.0 s. Documented as execute() territory (curated envel impose is mode 1). Mode 2 of extract (text brkfile, -d datareduce) stays uncurated; '.txt' sits in the output-format Literal for it.
Deterministic in the data chunk (raw bytes differ via the RIFF LIST date chunk - same trap as .ana, now recorded for .evl/.for too).
